methodology: Text/reference review of exact uncorrected recognition outputs against the official dataset references. This is not independent human listening validation.
The initial eight clips were fixed before recognition. No references, names, expected words or corrective hints were supplied to Whisper.
Classification separates meaningful errors from acceptable contractions, number formatting, transliteration and orthographic errors. WER is a diagnostic token-edit measure, not the semantic decision.
Small intentionally diagnostic native read-speech sample, not a random population sample, conversational/noisy speech benchmark, or accuracy guarantee.
The assembled longer Greek clip is recorded separately as technical regression coverage and is not an additional independent quality sample.

The first small, derived-small and Turbo runs predated explicit ONNX Runtime telemetry opt-outs. Installed ONNX Runtime was 1.32.0. HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 was configured; no outbound-network capture was performed, so those reports are not proof of whole-process offline privacy. Subsequent harness versions set ORT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 and HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 before ML imports and call onnxruntime.disable_telemetry_events().

classification_definitions.acceptable: No material content error observed; accepted punctuation, contraction or spelling conventions may differ.
classification_definitions.minor_issue: A limited word, spelling, grammar or precision problem needs correction while the central proposition remains recoverable.
classification_definitions.major_error: A proper name, proposition, semantic relationship or substantial content is incorrectly recognized.
classification_definitions.not_evaluable: No completed aligned transcript is available.

findings.pipeline: All eight uploads completed the real production recognition path, stored exact recognized segments in isolated SQLite, and produced matching TXT/SRT/VTT/JSON/ZIP exports. Records survived job eviction and a separate Python process read the same stored segments.
findings.timestamps: Eight short clips each yielded one segment. The derived 36.84-second Greek technical clip yielded five ordered segments, exercising multi-cue persistence and exports. All finite bounds and export cue checks passed; no independently annotated timing accuracy reference was available.
findings.quality: Turbo improves the exposed development examples and demonstrates useful ordinary speech transcription on the new eight-clip set: five acceptable, two minor spelling/grammar issues and one major damaged uncertainty qualifier. Outputs remain editable drafts requiring review; no general unattended accuracy approval is implied.
findings.numbers_and_negation: The fresh run preserves the at-least-two count, below-zero qualifier, six-mile amount, 1767 date, the habitat negation and the tap-water prohibition. The separate possibility qualifier in the hospital sentence is damaged and must be corrected by review.
findings.metrics: On this chosen sample only, literal normalized WER is 18/73 (24.66%) for Greek and 7/45 (15.56%) for English. These include harmless contractions, 3/τρεις and Manta/μάντα differences, and are not population accuracy estimates.

decision: Turbo has evidence of useful ordinary transcription as an editable draft, with visible review expectations for names, quantities, negation and uncertainty. The initial fresh result includes one material qualifier error; no general accuracy or unattended semantic approval is granted.

technical_regression.audio_encoding_note: Source samples are mono float32 16 kHz; PyAV output stream used its default stereo layout, yielding a dual-mono WAV. No new speech was synthesized.
technical_regression.meaning_assessment: Not approved. The collision injury predicate became δεν δραματήσει και κανείς, which does not faithfully preserve δεν τραυματίστηκε κανείς. The 5ο/πέμπτο and 4/τέσσερα representations preserve values. This run only establishes multi-cue workflow coverage.

development_designation: The initial eight fixed samples are now development cases because observed errors are informing candidate selection; subsequent comparisons are not untouched validation.

fresh_validation.subsequent_diagnostics: The initial fresh run is preserved unchanged. A later confidence probe reuses selected outputs and is explicitly postselection diagnostic evidence, not another untouched validation run.

candidate_comparison.reason: The fresh run demonstrates ordinary content usefulness and correct auto detection while retaining a material uncertainty-word error. A practical editable-draft workflow is supported; perfection on proper names or a general accuracy promise is not required or established. Production default selection remains a parent decision.
candidate_comparison.memory_scope: Turbo observed peak is about 1.64 GiB for the QA/application/model process alone; it excludes any simultaneously resident translation model and other processes.
candidate_comparison.latency_scope: Observed 49.461 seconds includes cold model loading and ordinary QA work; no controlled cross-model speed benchmark is claimed.

resource_observations.note: RSS was not instrumented in the initial run.

resource_interpretation: RSS is measured for the QA/application/model process only. Elapsed includes model loading and export checks; source versions, input sets, language mode and concurrent workload differ. Do not attribute all elapsed differences to model choice or automatic language detection, and do not extrapolate to combined ASR/translation whole-machine memory.

full_large_v3_advice.reason: The observed Turbo candidate already supports useful reviewable drafts. Full Large-v3 may help some errors but that benefit is unmeasured for these clips, while its larger decoder creates a CPU latency tradeoff for the four-core target. No claim is made that it would correct the observed names or uncertainty word.
full_large_v3_advice.source_fact: The primary model card describes Turbo as a pruned Large-v3 with four decoding layers instead of 32.

confidence_diagnostic.production_difference: word_timestamps=True was enabled only to expose actual word probabilities. All four produced exactly the saved production text. The current application does not retain these confidence fields.

observations.interpretation: The erroneous qualifier has a higher word score than the correctly rendered name; the misspelled infection verb has a very high score. A low-score filter can therefore miss real errors.
The severe English error is lower-confidence, so scores can provide review hints for some cases.

confidence_diagnostic.threshold_recommendation: No production semantic-approval or review-warning threshold is justified by four purposively selected probes. A 0.8 word threshold would flag the Greek uncertainty error and some English errors, but also the correct Dr./Moll rendering and would miss the incorrect μολύθηκαν at 0.93635. Segment-average confidence is also inadequate: the erroneous Greek sentence has a less negative average than the correct English control. If optional highlights are later introduced, call them review hints, never accuracy percentages, and validate them on new labeled material.
confidence_diagnostic.v1_recommendation: Keep an always-visible editable-draft review expectation. Do not let high confidence suppress review of names, quantities, negation, uncertainty or other consequential wording.

archive_provenance.checksum_scope: Existing report/manifest/source-report checksum fields refer to the original raw evidence. Sanitized artifact checksums are listed in artifact-index.json.
archive_provenance.transformations: Removed machine-local cache, artifact and dataset-extraction paths; made manifest paths relative; stripped signed URL query parameters if present. Reference text, hypotheses, judgments, numerical results and model/source hashes were preserved.
